 Let the culinary journey begin

From the Dosas of chennai to Delhi’s butter chicken, hyderabad’s biryani to kashmir’s rogan josh, we have tried to bring the flavours of India to you.

ORDER DELIVERY

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Welcome to Taste of India, where we invite you on a culinary journey to experience the rich and diverse flavors of India in the USA. Our restaurant is a celebration of the vibrant and delicious cuisine that India is known for.

Indulge in our carefully crafted menu, featuring an array of authentic Indian dishes made with love by our talented chefs. From aromatic curries to sizzling tandoori grills, our menu offers a delightful mix of traditional and modern Indian flavors that are sure to please your taste buds.

We take pride in using only the finest ingredients, sourced locally to ensure freshness and quality. Our team of skilled chefs create each dish with precision, using a harmonious blend of spices to create a symphony of flavors that will transport you to the streets of Delhi, the beaches of Goa, or the majestic palaces of Rajasthan.

At Taste of India, we are committed to providing exceptional service in a warm and inviting ambiance. Our friendly staff are here to make your dining experience truly memorable, whether you’re joining us for a romantic dinner, a family celebration, or a night out with friends.

For your convenience, we offer online ordering for takeout and delivery, so you can enjoy the taste of India wherever you are. We also offer catering services for special events, bringing the flavors of India to your gatherings and celebrations.

Visit us at or give us a call to reserve a table or place an order. We look forward to serving you and sharing the authentic Taste of India with you!
